steps.name: env-census
ac: test -f apps/api/tests/common/test_env_example_contract.py
cd apps/api && uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/common/test_env_example_contract.py -q
cd apps/api && test "$(uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/common/test_env_example_contract.py --collect-only -q 2>/dev/null | grep -c '::')" -ge 2
git diff --quiet -- apps/api/src
git diff --quiet -- apps/api/.env.example

steps.name: contract-guard-and-allowlist
ac: test -f apps/api/tests/common/test_env_example_contract.py
cd apps/api && uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/common/test_env_example_contract.py -q
cd apps/api && test "$(uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/common/test_env_example_contract.py --collect-only -q 2>/dev/null | grep -c '::')" -ge 4
cd apps/api && uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/common -q
git diff --quiet -- apps/api/src

steps.name: fill-env-example
ac: cd apps/api && uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/common/test_env_example_contract.py -q
test "$(grep -c '^E2E_RATE_LIMIT_EXEMPT_EMAIL=' apps/api/.env.example)" -eq 1
test "$(grep -c '^OPTIMIZER_STALE_THRESHOLD_SECONDS=' apps/api/.env.example)" -eq 1
test "$(grep -c '^STRESS_TEST_STALE_THRESHOLD_SECONDS=' apps/api/.env.example)" -eq 1
test "$(grep -c '^DOGFOOD_REPORT_OUTPUT_DIR=' apps/api/.env.example)" -eq 1
cd apps/api && uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/common -q
git diff --quiet -- apps/api/src

steps.name: mutation-selfcheck
ac: cd apps/api && uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/common/test_env_example_contract.py -q
cd apps/api && test "$(uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/common/test_env_example_contract.py --collect-only -q 2>/dev/null | grep -c '::')" -ge 6
cd apps/api && uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/common -q
cd apps/api && uv run ruff check tests/common/test_env_example_contract.py
cd apps/api && uv run ruff format --check tests/common/test_env_example_contract.py
git diff --quiet -- apps/api/src
